Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

OPENS Ch 5: MAQABIS-OF-MOAB INSTRUCTS HIS HOUSEHOLD IN TORAH from the Jewish captive-children he had brought from Jerusalem — the domestic-catechumenate INVERSION moment. The Gentile-king who had destroyed Jerusalem and enslaved its children now sits as PUPIL before those same captive-children, learning the Law-of-Moses from them. The reversal parallels: 2 KINGS 5:1-15 (Naaman the Syrian captain instructed-toward-faith by the captive-Israelite slave-girl); 1 KINGS 17:8-24 (Elijah hosted by the Zarephath widow — Phoenician-Gentile hospitality); 2 KINGS 6:8-23 (Elisha and the blinded-Syrian-soldiers fed-and-released as Aramean-Gentile evangelism); MATTHEW 8:5-13 (the centurion's faith exceeds-Israel's). The captive-child-as-teacher-of-king topos is one of the most structurally-developed inversions in the entire Meqabyan trilogy — anticipating Jesus's 'a little child shall lead them' (Isaiah 11:6 / read Christologically) and Matthew 18:3 ('except ye be converted, and become as little children').

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

OATH-TO-KEEP-THE-SABBATH — Maqabis-of-Moab's pivotal Sabbatical commitment (vv. 14-18). The Sabbath-keeping vow is the DIAGNOSTIC-MARK OF GENUINE GENTILE-CONVERSION in Hebrew-Bible and Second-Temple thought: ISAIAH 56:1-8 ('the sons of the stranger that join themselves to the LORD... every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it'); NEHEMIAH 13:15-22 (Sabbath-trade enforcement); ISAIAH 58:13-14 (Sabbath-honor = heaven's-favor); JUBILEES 2:17-33 + 50 (the Sabbath-cosmogony + Jubilees-Sabbath-laws — Tewahedo-canonical Mäṣḥafä Kufāle parallel reading); EXODUS 31:13-17 (Sabbath as covenant-sign). Meqabyan's Sabbath-oath has distinctive Maccabean-resonance: 1 MACCABEES 2:32-41 (the LXX-Maccabean Sabbath-fighting controversy and Mattathias's ruling); 2 MACCABEES 6:11 (the Sabbath-cave-massacre). The Meqabyan oath functions as the structural-FULL-CONVERSION marker — Maqabis-of-Moab is now covenant-bound under the Sabbath-stipulation that distinguishes Israel from the nations.
